description: Filter, compact — low-pass, high-pass, band-pass or band-reject, switched

params.text: Attenuverts the cutoff CV before it is added to the cutoff knob's position

inputs.text: The signal to be filtered; the channels patched here set the polyphony
A CV over the cutoff, 5V either way, attenuverted by the small knob and added to the cutoff knob's position

menu: Slope — the filter slope, from 1 pole to 12 poles
Bandwidth mode — Pitched puts the band edges an equal pitch either side of the centre, to a maximum of two octaves; Linear puts them an equal number of hertz either side, to a maximum of 2000Hz
